tasks.corrected_reference_answer: OriginTrialTokenWithStatus contains raw_token_text, required status and optional parsed_token. Serialization delegates status.to_json and, when present, parsed_token.to_json; deserialization delegates the respective from_json methods and converts rawTokenText to str (src/streamlink/webbrowser/cdp/devtools/page.py:476-499). This is hierarchical composition with bidirectional conversion, not a circular class dependency.

tasks.corrected_reference_answer: TouchPoint stores normalized tangential_pressure in [-1,1] and independent tilt_x/tilt_y orientation angles in [-90,90]. The comments define the Y-Z/stylus-Y and X-Z/stylus-X planes and positive directions (src/streamlink/webbrowser/cdp/devtools/input_.py:40-47). These describe pressure and stylus orientation; the class does not derive a complete 3D force vector from them. force and twist are separate optional properties (37-50).

tasks.corrected_reference_answer: The existing test fixture demonstrates interface-compatible extension: SegmentPrefetch subclasses Segment and overrides build(namespace) to emit #EXT-X-TWITCH-PREFETCH using inherited url(namespace) (tests/plugins/test_twitch.py:161-163). A proposed playlist-test extension can follow that pattern while leaving ordinary Segment behavior intact. This class generates test playlist text; it is not the production segment-fetching mechanism, and backward compatibility of a new fetcher requires separate behavioral validation.
